messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

I’m sorry, but we can’t send the refund to a new card. It can only go to the order’s original payment, even if that card was cancelled; the card issuer handles the credit (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to proceed with a refund to the original payment?
